mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees and foggy near the Verona Public Library. If you are looking to the stars tonight, you are in luck as the International Space Station will be visible for five minutes starting at 7:40 PM, rising in the northwest over Middleton and Verona High School before heading northeast near Home Depot, remaining low near the horizon.

The city has announced that chip seal road treatment begins on Wednesday, September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park, so expect some lane closures. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review several development projects, including site plans for Sub-Zero.

It is a busy couple of days for local fun. Today features the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, the Dane County Farmers Market, and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can Bike the Barns tomorrow or join in for various trivia nights starting on Monday.

In our weekly police report, we look back to September 5, when officers investigated a viral social media prank involving cheese placed on multiple vehicle windshields in the downtown area. Thankfully, no damage was reported.
Culver's is currently open until 10:30 PM for your convenience, though please be aware that the store is currently undergoing a remodel and the flavor of the day is not available at this time.
